hints.title: Ring Buffer Index Arithmetic
hints.text: Manage head and tail pointers modulo capacity over a preallocated array to reuse buffer slots continuously.

hints.title: Head and Count Tracking State
hints.text: Store fixed capacity k, current item count, and head index. Tail index is computed via (head + count - 1) % k.

hints.title: Circular Queue Blueprint
hints.text: enQueue(v): if isFull return False, write at (head + count) % k, count += 1, return True. deQueue(): if isEmpty return False, head = (head + 1) % k, count -= 1, return True. Front: return queue[head] if not isEmpty else -1. Rear: return queue[(head+count-1)%k] if not isEmpty else -1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: maximum capacity of circular queue
complexity.notes: All queue operations execute in strict O(1) time with fixed size array allocation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Dynamic arrays without circular wrapping require O(N) shifts on each dequeue operation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates fixed array of size K once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of modular arithmetic and tracking size to distinguish full from empty.
